name: huSSH
author: Wizard-NetEng
description: A compact SSH client in the bar: grouped session list imported from SecureCRT or PuTTY, live reachability dots, and one-click connect in your default terminal. TACACS credentials are held in the kernel keyring for a limited window, never written to disk.

barWidget.description: Dropdown of SSH sessions with reachability status and one-click connect

schema.label: Probe reachability
schema.description: Background TCP check of each host's SSH port to drive the status dots.

schema.label: Probe interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-sweep all hosts. Only runs while the popup has been opened at least once.

schema.label: Probe timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Per-host TCP connect timeout. Raise it on high-latency WAN links.

schema.label: Credential hold (minutes)
schema.description: How long the TACACS password stays cached in the kernel keyring before it expires itself.

schema.label: Hide unreachable hosts
schema.description: Show only hosts that answered the last probe sweep.
